rationale: The operator accepted the standalone industrial hall as #167 and approved the separate debris/window rock-room candidate for its exact candidate identity.
Frames 1097 and 4560 show distinct source views at different timeline positions; their spatial relationship and connectivity are unknown.
The assembled connection is an explicit authored game doorway. It is not recovered from the source video.
The Hunyuan panoramas are broad visual references; neither is rendered as a world background in the room assembly.

observations.claim: Frame_1097 shows the directly observed industrial hall used as the first room design.
Frames_4336–4936 show a visually distinct debris/window interior; the debris is observed, but natural rock is not established.
The footage does not establish the two zones as adjacent or connected; the doorway and relative placement are authored.

unknowns: Camera pose, world orientation, metric scale, room dimensions and true ceiling height are unknown.
The full perimeter and any hidden openings are not visible in the selected source coverage.
The relation between the dark passage in frame_4936 and this candidate is unknown; the candidate has no connection to it.
The source floor clutter is ambiguous. The rock and gravel field is an authored interpretation guided by the accepted panorama and operator direction, not a claim that rocks are directly observed.
The candidate shell is a bounded gameplay design, not a recovered source floor plan.
The source does not establish the adjacency, metric scale, or connectivity of the two selected zones.
The direct doorway position, width, height, wall depth, and room relative placement are authored game geometry.

reusable_requirements.coordinate_convention: Godot local X/Z with +Y up; all dimensions are uncalibrated design units.
reusable_requirements.supported_footprint_representation: Finite simple orthogonal rectangle with one spawn-connected single-level walkable region.

player.safe_spawn_and_reset: Spawn at [0,0.6,4.1] in the industrial hall, facing the authored south doorway; R restores this exact pose and zero velocity.

reusable_requirements.floor_and_ceiling: Authored floor at Y=0 and closed ceiling underside at Y=3.92; values describe the candidate, not the footage.
reusable_requirements.collision_policy: Separate floor and four perimeter colliders; 72 large rock-bank colliders, one pathside boulder collider and one pier collider; 336 small gravel meshes are visual only.
reusable_requirements.render_placement_policy: Authored 12×10-unit closed shell; no panorama or exterior background geometry is rendered.
reusable_requirements.socket_policy: No authored sockets. All four candidate boundaries are closed; no source opening or video connectivity is inferred.
additional_constraints: Use the existing player controller and accepted PSX compositor/material profile.

walkable_space.coordinate_system: World Godot X/Z with +Y up; authored design units are uncalibrated.

measurement.method: Godot 4.6.3 tested standalone spawn/reset in both adapters; 25 capsule overlap probes through a 1.2-unit approach on both sides of the doorway; bidirectional player traversal/backtracking and floor/boundary controls. No exhaustive connected-area grid was run.

boundary_and_obstacle_collision.collision_origin: All floors, perimeter walls, doorway returns/headers, rocks, columns, and obstacles are explicit authored collision bodies separate from visual meshes. The continuous doorway floor-seam collider is a new authored bridge.
boundary_and_obstacle_collision.exposed_boundary_policy: All perimeter edges are closed except the matched hall-south/rock-north doorway; each socket is capped in its standalone adapter scene. SafetyNet bodies are fall recovery aids only.

rendered_placement_envelope.containment_method: Two closed authored room shells with one matched doorway cut; the candidate runtime test checked every MeshInstance3D AABB corner against the declared combined envelope and found zero escapes. There is no panorama background geometry.

surfaces.geometry_origin: Existing accepted #167 hall geometry through a versioned south-socket adapter; six support columns and floor obstacles retain their accepted placements.
surfaces.appearance_origin: The accepted #167 direct-source textures and PSX treatment are reused unchanged.
surfaces.placement_basis: World origin [0,0,0], authored footprint X=[-8,8], Z=[-6.5,6.5]; uncalibrated.
surfaces.collision_origin: Separate authored floor, wall, column and slab colliders; the south doorway is formed by matching visual wall segments and collision bodies.

surfaces.geometry_origin: The operator-reviewed standalone room geometry is reused through a versioned north-socket adapter; the central route remains open between authored rock banks.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Direct-source wall/window crops and authored low-poly rock palette remain unchanged from the reviewed standalone design.
surfaces.placement_basis: World origin [0,0,11.5], authored footprint X=[-6,6], world Z=[6.5,16.5]; uncalibrated. Rock interpretation is authored, not directly observed.
surfaces.collision_origin: Separate authored floor, wall, rock, pier and obstacle colliders; the north doorway replaces only its capped boundary in this assembly variant.

surfaces.geometry_origin: A new matched 2.4-by-2.2 opening at hall-south/rock-north, with a 0.6-unit combined wall depth, shared visual jamb/header trim, and a short threshold strip.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Untextured muted PSX trim chosen to bridge two room wall languages; this connection material is new and provisional.
surfaces.placement_basis: Socket centers both resolve to world [0,0,6.5]; normals oppose and both floors are at Y=0. Source footage does not place this doorway.
surfaces.collision_origin: Matching wall/header colliders preserve the opening; a separate floor seam box supports the doorway span. Runtime capsule probes and traversal checks passed.

manual_decisions: Keep the accepted standalone rock-room baseline unchanged and use a versioned north-socket adapter.
Cut one south socket into the accepted hall through a separate adapter; the original hall scene stays unchanged.
Align the two adapters at the shared z=6.5 wall with equal 2.4-by-2.2 opening and level floor.
Keep all unused boundaries capped and mark the connection as authored rather than source-proven.
authoring_log.effort: Active authoring time not measured. Connector geometry and integration are manually authored.

operator_decision.scope: Operator accepts this exact two-room assembly, its authored hall-south to rock-room-north doorway, and the tested bidirectional traversal. It does not claim source-video connectivity, calibrated scale, or general socket compatibility.
